summary: Rivas received 'Strong Support' from California Jewish Democrats, the renamed Democrats for Israel California, its highest tier. He voted aye on AB 715, which establishes an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight, and a 2026 Palestinian rights coalition alleges he blocked AB 2159, a bill to correct AB 715's definition conflating pro-Palestine speech with discrimination. In October 2023, Rivas condemned the attack on Israel, stating nothing justifies killing innocent civilians.
